messages:
Nina: Heads-up  were prepping NovaApps pre-renewal QBR. Focus: concise cost snapshot + ops asks. Need owners for a 60d spend trend, top token drivers, and a one-page customer ask.
Priya: I can lead coordination. @Dan 60d trend + scenario model? @Marta top token drivers and quick mitigations? Omar can draft the customer-facing ask?
Dan: Yep. Ill pull 60d token/day, highlight any day >25% of monthly tokens, and run 3 scenarios (base, +30% activation, -15% after optim). CSV by EOD.
Marta: Ill sample recent calls and tag families: "long-summary", "bulk-embed", "mass-personalize". Will add avg tokens/call and one-line mitigation per family.
Omar: Ill draft a one-pager with 3 asks: (1) temporary quota bump for pilot, (2) 1 dev sprint for prompt trimming, (3) enablement session on batching. Will include suggested customer email.
Nina: Great. Thresholds to show in the deck: +15% MTD alert, +30% absolute, and single-day >35% daily share. Flag any downstream jobs that can be deferred.
alerts-bot: Console alerts created: +15% MTD, +30% absolute. Owners: @Priya, @Dan.
Dan: Quick preview snippet:
```
Scenario,EstMonthlyCost
Base,$2,900
Activation+30%,$3,770
Optimized-15%,$2,465
```
Marta: Mitigations short list: enable prefix caching for transcripts, schedule embedding batches midnight-6am, reduce few-shot examples from 5->2 for mass emails. Will put configs in /team-playbooks/nova-costs.md
Priya: Please also add a 2-question poll in the enablement deck: "Which jobs can be nightly?" and "Which outputs could accept lower fidelity?" Capture the examples live so we can include them in the QBR appendix.
Omar: Draft one-pager posted to #customer-docs as WIP. Ping me for wording tweaks.
Nina: Thanks all. If any spike >20% day-over-day appears in the next 48h, alert here and well consider emergency quota or rollback. :thumbsup:
